g.text: The drift monitor stays quiet on every stable week and flags every shifted one

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Carlito', 'Calibri', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: 400 messages a week at 2% phishing; from week 6, a quarter of traffic is mail the model was not trained on. Bands are calibrated on stable,

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'Carlito', 'Calibri', 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: campaign-structured weeks: 'moderate' is their 95th percentile, so about one stable week in twenty is expected to reach it.
